patches.summary: classifySentiment returns 'none' when total==0 instead of 'negative'.
patches.reason: A zero-review result (total==0, avg==0.0) triggered the avg<3.0 threshold and returned 'negative'. Greptile flagged this as a P1 correctness bug. Added total>0 guard and explicit 'no reviews found' message.

patches.summary: keywords_track passes splitTrimmed+Join result to API instead of raw flagKeywords string.
patches.reason: rank_fanout applies splitTrimmed before joining keywords for the API call; track did not, so leading spaces after commas could cause silent API mismatches. Greptile noted the inconsistency at 5/5 review.
patches.validated_outcome: go build ./... and go vet ./... pass; existing tests pass.

patches.summary: Generated command Example strings use real values (app 324684580, country us, keywords music) instead of example-value/your-token-here placeholders.
patches.reason: The dogfood harness runs Example: strings verbatim; placeholders were rejected by the API with HTTP 422.

patches.summary: Corrected 17 endpoint paths that did not exist on AppTweak's API, and routed /apptweak/* reference endpoints to the sibling /api/public/apptweak base.
patches.reason: The paths in the generated spec returned Rails route-not-found 404s on every plan (e.g. /utils/countries.json), not plan-tier limits. Paths now match developers.apptweak.com's published OpenAPI: keywords-rankings, keywords/bids, metadata/changes, featured_content/filter, reviews/top-displayed, charts/top-results, keywords/search-results, keywords/suggestions/{app,category}, keywords/apps/bids, categories/metrics, categories/benchmarks, and /apptweak/{countries,languages,dnas,usage/credits}.
patches.validated_outcome: Live dogfood (level full, PP 4.27.0): 142 pass / 0 fail, verdict PASS.

patches.summary: Aligned request parameters with the documented API: required `metrics` (6 commands), `metric` on category metrics, categories/countries/keyword/term/start_date/end_date/dna_ids/types/store wire names, top-displayed `sort` enum, optional start/end dates on the bids commands; removed undocumented rating, type and category params.
patches.reason: The generated commands sent parameter names and values the API rejects (HTTP 422 ValidationError) or silently ignores.

patches.summary: Novel-command parsers now read AppTweak's {"result": {"<app id>": ...}} envelope (rank-fanout, track, paid-organic-gap, metadata-diff, reviews sentiment, credits status); rank lookups send metrics=rank and are limited to 5 keywords per request.
patches.reason: The parsers looked for content/data/results keys that AppTweak never returns. metadata-diff reported every field as unchanged, and the others returned empty results, once the endpoint paths were fixed. Verified against captured live responses; envelope_test.go covers each shape.
patches.validated_outcome: go test ./internal/cli passes; each novel command returned real data live.

patches.summary: paid-organic-gap gains --days (default 7) to bound the paid-keyword window, chunks rank lookups into groups of 5, and requests aggregated bids.
patches.reason: apps/keywords/bids bills 1,000 credits for the first day plus 100 per extra day; the default 30-day window cost about 3,900 credits per call.
patches.validated_outcome: paid-organic-gap --days 1 returned 61 paid keywords and ranked the top 50, at 1,522 credits.
